sentences.chinese: 请在开始工作前阅读安全手册。
sentences.english: Please read the safety manual before you start work.
sentences.focusZh: 祈使句 + before 时间从句
accepted: Read the safety manual before you start work.

sentences.chinese: 进入车间之前，你必须戴上护目镜。
sentences.english: You must wear safety glasses before you enter the shop.
sentences.focusZh: 情态动词 must 表示强制要求
accepted: You must put on safety glasses before you enter the shop.

sentences.chinese: 如果警报响起，立刻离开作业区。
sentences.english: If the alarm sounds, leave the work area immediately.
accepted: If the alarm goes off, leave the work area immediately.

sentences.chinese: 这个零件不符合图纸上的规格。
sentences.english: This part does not meet the specification on the drawing.
accepted: This part does not meet the specifications on the drawing.

sentences.chinese: 切断电源后再打开配电箱。
sentences.english: Turn off the power before you open the panel.
accepted: Switch off the power before you open the panel.

sentences.chinese: 主管要求我们把泄漏立刻报告上去。
sentences.english: The supervisor told us to report the leak immediately.
accepted: The supervisor asked us to report the leak immediately.

sentences.chinese: 在安装之前，先检查梯子是否稳固。
sentences.english: Inspect the ladder for stability before you install it.
sentences.focusZh: before 从句 + 技术动词 inspect
accepted: Check the ladder for stability before you install it.

sentences.chinese: 损坏的个人防护用品必须更换，不能继续使用。
sentences.english: Damaged PPE must be replaced and must not be reused.
sentences.focusZh: 情态动词被动：must be replaced
accepted: Damaged PPE must be replaced and cannot be reused.

sentences.chinese: 请按正确顺序执行上锁程序。
sentences.english: Please carry out the lockout procedure in the correct order.
accepted: Carry out the lockout procedure in the correct order.

sentences.chinese: 我们中午前就把紧固件用完了。
sentences.english: We ran out of fasteners before noon.
sentences.focusZh: 动词短语 run out of + 过去时
accepted: We ran out of fasteners before noon.

sentences.chinese: 绝不要站在悬吊重物下面。
sentences.english: Never stand under a suspended load.
accepted: Do not stand under a suspended load.

sentences.chinese: 把扭力扳手设置到规定数值。
sentences.english: Set the torque wrench to the specified value.
sentences.focusZh: 不规则动词 set（三种形式相同）
accepted: Set the torque wrench to the specified setting.

sentences.chinese: 如果你不确定这个词，就去查词典。
sentences.english: If you are not sure about the word, look it up in a dictionary.
sentences.focusZh: 可分动词短语 look it up
accepted: If you are not sure of the word, look it up in a dictionary.

sentences.chinese: 有力的论证需要清楚的主张和相关证据。
sentences.english: A strong argument needs a clear claim and relevant evidence.
accepted: A strong argument requires a clear claim and relevant evidence.

sentences.chinese: 动笔前先确保你理解了题目。
sentences.english: Make sure you understand the question before you start writing.
accepted: Make sure you understand the question before you write.

sentences.chinese: 虽然这个想法有趣，但它缺少证据。
sentences.english: Although the idea is interesting, it lacks evidence.
accepted: Although the idea is interesting, it does not have enough evidence.

sentences.chinese: 证据不足，因此该主张不成立。
sentences.english: The evidence was weak; therefore, the claim failed.
accepted: The evidence was weak, so the claim failed.

sentences.chinese: 把中心论点放在引言的结尾。
sentences.english: Put your thesis at the end of the introduction.
accepted: Place your thesis at the end of the introduction.

sentences.chinese: 要解释引文，而不是只把它抄下来。
sentences.english: Interpret the quotation; do not just copy it.
accepted: Interpret the quotation instead of just copying it.

sentences.chinese: 每一个段落都应该只展开一个中心意思。
sentences.english: Each paragraph should develop one controlling idea.
accepted: Each paragraph should develop one main idea.

sentences.chinese: 根据评分标准，语法仍然会影响分数。
sentences.english: According to the rubric, grammar still affects the mark.
accepted: According to the rubric, grammar still affects the grade.

sentences.chinese: 相比之下，工科测评更侧重实用阅读。
sentences.english: In contrast, the trades assessment focuses on practical reading.
accepted: In contrast, the trades assessment focuses on practical reading skills.

sentences.chinese: 删除与中心论点无关的细节。
sentences.english: Delete details that are not relevant to the thesis.
sentences.focusZh: 定语从句 that are not relevant
accepted: Remove details that are not relevant to the thesis.

sentences.chinese: 英语 12 达到 50% 即可满足第三类要求。
sentences.english: English Studies 12 with 50 percent meets the Category 3 requirement.
sentences.focusZh: 不规则动词 meet 的第三人称
accepted: English Studies 12 with 50% meets the Category 3 requirement.

sentences.chinese: 同等的英语课程也可能被接受。
sentences.english: An equivalent English course may also be accepted.
sentences.focusZh: 情态动词被动 may be accepted
accepted: An equivalent English course may be accepted as well.

sentences.chinese: 录取取决于你的专业英语类别是否达标。
sentences.english: Admission depends on meeting the English category for your program.
accepted: Admission depends on whether you meet the English category for your program.

sentences.chinese: 他去工具房登记领取电钻。
sentences.english: He went to the tool crib to sign out a drill.
accepted: He went to the tool crib to check out a drill.

sentences.chinese: 更换损坏的管道花了三个小时。
sentences.english: It took three hours to replace the damaged pipe.
sentences.focusZh: It took ... to do；take 的过去式 took
accepted: It took three hours to replace the damaged pipe.

sentences.chinese: 下雨后地面变得很滑。
sentences.english: The surface became slippery after the rain.
accepted: The ground became slippery after the rain.

sentences.chinese: 不要把今天到期的复习往后拖。
sentences.english: Do not put off the reviews that are due today.
accepted: Don't put off the reviews that are due today.

sentences.chinese: 交段落前把评分标准仔细过一遍。
sentences.english: Go through the rubric before you submit the paragraph.
accepted: Go over the rubric before you submit the paragraph.

sentences.chinese: 请提前十五分钟到场参加英语测评。
sentences.english: Please show up fifteen minutes early for the English assessment.
accepted: Show up fifteen minutes early for the English assessment.

sentences.chinese: 如果连续两天不复习，你就会落后。
sentences.english: You will fall behind if you skip two days of review.
accepted: If you skip two days of review, you will fall behind.

sentences.chinese: 间隔练习的意义，就是在快忘记之前复习。
sentences.english: The point of spaced practice is to review just before you forget.
accepted: Spaced practice means you review just before you forget.

sentences.chinese: 她写了一段话，并用证据支撑自己的观点。
sentences.english: She wrote a paragraph and supported her point with evidence.
accepted: She wrote a paragraph and supported her idea with evidence.

sentences.chinese: 沟通不清导致装错了零件。
sentences.english: Poor communication led to the wrong part being installed.
accepted: Poor communication led to installing the wrong part.

sentences.chinese: 开机前必须把防护罩装回去。
sentences.english: Put the guard back before you restart the machine.
sentences.focusZh: 不规则动词 put（三种形式相同）
accepted: Put the guard back on before you restart the machine.

sentences.chinese: 尽管任务很难，它仍然是必须完成的。
sentences.english: The task is difficult; nevertheless, it is required.
accepted: Although the task is difficult, it is still required.

sentences.chinese: 一个轶事还不足以作为证据。
sentences.english: One anecdote is not sufficient evidence.
accepted: One anecdote is not enough evidence.

sentences.chinese: 所有学生都必须遵守车间安全规定。
sentences.english: All students must comply with shop safety rules.
accepted: Every student must comply with the shop safety rules.
